name: How long does it take for a plumber to clear a clogged floor drain?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take for a plumber to clear a clogged floor drain?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time it takes to clear a clogged floor drain depends on the complexity and location of the blockage. Simple clogs can often be resolved within an hour. More stubborn clogs, those requiring specialized equipment like a camera inspection or hydro-jetting, or clogs located deep within the main line, may take a few hours. We always aim for efficient service to minimize disruption at your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clearing a clogged floor drain can take from under an hour for simple clogs to a few hours for more complex or deeper blockages requiring specialized equipment.
